redirects.//: Real Enterprise content lived at this alias, but PageMeta has no entry for it, so it was served with the 404's noindex tag. Redirect it to the canonical page.

Routes resolve case-insensitively (react-router) and canonicals are lowercase, so /About and /about both returned 200 with identical content — duplicate URLs for non-JS crawlers. 301 the capitalised forms to the canonical lowercase. Only affects hard loads / crawlers; in-app SPA navigation never hits the edge.
